title: Agai Bint-e-Ali Be Rida Haath Bandhay
body:
Jis Nay Suuraj Na Kabhi Dekha Tha (x2)
Ro Rahi Hai Wooh Ghuna Gharon Main
<<DIVIDER>>
Koun Janay Kay Yeh Hain Koun Rassan Pehnay Howay
Be Rida Roti Hai Sajjad Kay Peechay Peechay
Siskiyan Dhubi Hai Jis Bibi Ki
Haye Zanjeeron Ki Jhinkaron Main
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Zahra Teri Kismat Na Mila Haq Tujh Ko
Aisi Tazeem Teri Ki Hai Musalmano Nay
Tera Haq Mangnay Aai Zainab
Aik Maynoosh Kay Darbaron Main
<<DIVIDER>>
Kahan Zainab Aur Kahan Shaam Kay Logon Ka Hajoom
Sir Barhaina Unchi Awaz May Khutbay Parhna
Khatm E Mursal Ka Hawala Day Ker
Chadaran Mangna Bad Karon Say
<<DIVIDER>>
Aag Khaimon May Lagi Aur Thay Sajjad Bay Hosh
Ro Ro Abbas Ko Deti Thi Saddain Zainab
Loot Lo Chadarain Sedanion Ki
Shoor Bharpa Tha Sittamgaron Main
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis Tarhan Bali Sakina Rahay Baba Kay Baghair
So Gai Chain Say Tanhai May Rotay Rotay
Hichkiyan Dab Gai Masooma Ki
Haye Zindanon Ki Deewaron Main
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Jaghan Majlis E Shabeer Ho Bharpa Akhter
Choor Ker Baqiya Ko Roti Hai Zahra Akay
Baal Kholay Sir Peetti Hai
Apnay Piyaron Kay Zadaron Main
